title: Qimbô qabli aysinul caxitte
intro: taswiir naharsi ayroora seehadayti baxi, inkih yan baad inki buxah marak suge wak. Atu namma fida Yallih foocal elle daffeysan innal table — tiya oggolteh, gersitti oggolteh. Aysinu sorkocô baxat ramid leeh, bohoy naqabut tutucya. Ciggiltam aydaadul amotani asta cabeleeh, qunxa kimmir takke way barseena akkele.
clues: Anu ardi bagul qimbô buxah mara kinniyo.
Anu Yallah fida xayyoyse, takkay immay yi fida moggolinna gersi fida sugte wak.
Anu aysinuh yaabeeh, mano beyyoh meysiseh.
Anu ardi bagul qemmoh addah qadli sinni qidim abe.
Anu ubleh kuraani ardi koqso yoo yaybulleemih xagar mannal yaaqureenim.
Anu nadaama kibuk raaqeh sugeeh, yi gaba abteemih gacte marih fanat cule.

trial.answer: xayyos cinnimeek widiril toobokoh aysinu qideenim

options: Nadaama tekkeeh, gacteh tan maritteh fanat
barasih biyaakah malcina sanatah yoogoreh suge
outcome.answer: Nadaama tekkeeh, gacteh tan maritteh fanat

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
